RCE-VC Structural Admission Prototype [E/M · reported_j]

In openIE-dev/rce-vc (v0.1.0, 49 offline tests), single-unit edits admit into a 100k-unit 16-way Merkle trie in 69.7-73.6 us and 317.2-365.4 uJ (M5 Max L3 reported_j) — a prototype contract, not a Git benchmark.

1/2 Rename invariance vs key collisions:
- Parent slot bindings allow pure function renames without changing positional unit key(u)
- Candid collision hazard: distinct untyped functions with identical normalized bodies (f(x,y)=x+y vs g(a,b)=a+b) share the exact same key(u)

2/2 Unbuilt milestones & scope:
- Zero head-to-head conflict-precision benchmarks run yet vs git merge-ort, GumTree, Spork, or Mergiraf
- Cross-file symbol graphs, TypeScript splitters & native Git packfiles remain open in v0.1.0
- M5 Max L3 reported_j only (measured_j = null)
